meta.name: google-ads-assets
meta.description: Plan, validate, and safely publish Google Ads assets, including sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, image assets, and Performance Max asset briefs. Use when asked for Google Ads assets, ad extensions, sitelinks, callouts, snippets, image assets, Performance Max assets, PMax creative, or an asset audit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划验证并发布谷歌广告素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责谷歌广告素材,需要安全地把扩展和图片资产发布上线。
copy.tagline_en: Plan, validate, and publish Google Ads assets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads assets and need a safe way to publish them.

howto.what: 装上后,它会先读取业务背景与人物画像,再基于现有广告数据和已批准证据,生成待审核的素材清单,列明素材类型、适用层级、创意角度、文案方向、证据来源、落地页与状态。您批准后才会创建或关联;背景缺失或连线不可用时,只转交审计或给制作简报,不会擅自发布。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划或发布 Google Ads 素材(如站内链接、宣传信息、图片素材等),或提出 PMax 创意、素材审计需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个广告组规划几条宣传信息,并标注证据状态。
say.note: Claude 会生成可审核的素材清单。

say.text: 给这款产品做一份 PMax 素材简报,列出还缺哪些图片素材。
say.note: 输出包含概念卡和缺口清单。

say.text: 审计现有站内链接,检查哪些声明需要补充依据。
say.note: Claude 会先核对证据状态再给结论。

howto.what_en: Claude uses approved data and evidence to output a reviewable asset manifest; it only creates assets after approval. Without context/live connection, it provides an audit handoff or brief, never claiming publication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for Google Ads assets, such as sitelinks, callouts, image assets, etc., or for PMax creative or an asset audit.

say_en.text: Plan a few callouts for this ad group and mark evidence status.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a reviewable manifest.

say_en.text: Create a PMax asset brief for this product, list missing images.
say_en.note: Output includes concept cards and gaps.

say_en.text: Audit existing sitelinks and flag claims that need substantiation.
say_en.note: Claude checks evidence before suggesting changes.
